payload.content: A notification settings payload specifies the restriction enforced notification settings for apps using their bundle identifier. The profile specifies notification settings by bundle identifier (even for apps that aren’t installed on the device yet), and those settings will always be enforced.

payloadkeys.title: Notification settings
payloadkeys.content: An array of notification settings dictionaries.

subkeys.title: App bundle identifier
subkeys.content: The bundle identifier of the app to which to apply these notification settings.

subkeys.title: Enable notifications
subkeys.content: If `true`, enables notifications for this app.

subkeys.title: Show in Notification Center
subkeys.content: If `true`, enables notifications in the Notification Center for this app.

subkeys.title: Show in Lock Screen
subkeys.content: If `true`, enables notifications on the Lock Screen for this app.

subkeys.title: Alert type
subkeys.content:
The type of alert for notifications for this app:

- `0`: None
- `1`: Temporary Banner
- `2`: Persistent Banner

subkeys.title: Badges enabled
subkeys.content: If `true`, enables badges for this app.

subkeys.title: Sounds enabled
subkeys.content: If `true`, enables sounds for this app.

subkeys.title: Show in CarPlay
subkeys.content: If `true`, enables notifications in CarPlay for this app.

subkeys.title: Critical alert enabled
subkeys.content: If `true`, enables critical alerts that can ignore Do Not Disturb and ringer settings for this app.

subkeys.title: Grouping type
subkeys.content:
The type of grouping for notifications for this app:

- `0`: Automatic: Group notifications into app-specified groups.
- `1`: By app: Group notifications into one group.
- `2`: Off: Don't group notifications.

subkeys.title: Preview type
subkeys.content:
The type previews for notifications. This key overrides the value at Settings>Notifications>Show Previews.

- `0` - Always: The device shows previews when locked and unlocked
- `1` - When Unlocked: The device shows previews only when unlocked
- `2` - Never: The device never shows previews
